column1: # Heart (Chalice), the Kolima secret boss. Also names rows 101 and 104.

column3: ...Matthew? No, you died\nwhen that world burned. I\nwatched it fall.{end_wait}
Matthew? My name is Isaac.\nI don't know you.{end_wait}
Same face, same stance. How\ndid you live through the\nend of everything?{end_wait}
Isaac, step back. She's\nlooking at you like she's\nseen a ghost.{end_wait}
If you survived, then so\ndid my hatred. I'll finish\nwhat the fall began.{end_wait}
She won't listen, so I'll\nhave to stop her.{end_wait}
...You aren't him. Matthew\ncould never have beaten me\nlike this.{end_wait}

Then not every world ended
the same. Mine did. So did
Ash Jenna's.{page_break}Ask her what the fall left.
Remember my name: Heart.{end_wait}
Take your prize, stranger.\nWe'll meet again, whoever\nyou are.{end_wait}
